## Summary

Describe the problem and the change. List affected routes and components.

## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] UI/UX improvement
- [ ] Accessibility improvement
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Test or CI maintenance
- [ ] Backend integration boundary

## Implementation details

Explain important decisions and any new dependencies or data contracts.

## Validation

- [ ] Ran `npm ci`.
- [ ] Ran `npm test -- --watchAll=false`.
- [ ] Ran `npm run build`.
- [ ] Tested affected routes.
- [ ] Checked mobile and desktop layouts.
- [ ] Checked keyboard behavior and accessible names.
- [ ] Confirmed no secrets or real customer data were added.
- [ ] Updated documentation where needed.

## Screenshots

Attach before/after screenshots for visible changes. Remove private information.

## Backend and data impact

State whether the change is frontend-only. Do not claim an order, payment, or authentication flow works unless a real backend contract and verification exist.

## Known limitations

List remaining issues and follow-up work.
